name: puzzolana-machinery-platform
description: Enterprise Website & Digital Platform for Puzzolana Machinery

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgYellow.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgYellow.bold" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend

author: Puzzolana Engineering Team
